# FxDateRange (component)

`import { FxDateRange } from '@fixtures/single-entry';`

Selector: `fx-date-range`

Date range picker. Its templateUrl points to a missing file: no slots, no crash.

## Two-way bindings (model)
Each one also works as `[name]` + `(nameChange)`.

- `[(start)]: Date | undefined` — Start of the range.
